publications.title: Kanawa tsugite
publications.description: In the realm of design, the most elegant solutions often emerge from the harmonious balance between function and form. Kanawa-tsugite, a sophisticated Japanese woodworking joint, exemplifies this principle through centuries of refinement. This joining technique transcends its utilitarian origins, teaching modern designers crucial lessons about material integrity, structural elegance, and the power of constraint-driven innovation. By studying its precise geometries and thoughtful construction, we gain insights into how limitations can foster creativity, how complexity can arise from simple rules, and how structural requirements can give birth to aesthetic beauty. Through this exploration of Kanawa-tsugite, we'll uncover how traditional craftsmanship continues to inform contemporary design thinking, offering valuable principles for creating solutions that are both technically sound and visually compelling.

publications.title: The Case for Custom AI
publications.description: While large language models promise universal solutions, their limitations in specialized contexts make a compelling case for custom AI development. This article explores how building tailored models that embrace uncertainty and continuous learning can better serve specific business needs, ensure cost control, and maintain compliance while avoiding the pitfalls of false confidence inherent in general-purpose AI solutions.

documents.\"The Myth of Universal Models\": A paper by Andrej Karpathy discussing the limitations of large-scale models

documents.\"Stochastic Parrots\": Emily M. Bender's influential paper on the limitations of large language models

documents.\"Domain-Specific AI\": A comprehensive guide by Andrew Ng on building specialized AI solutions

documents.\"The False Promise of All-Purpose AI\": Analysis of specialized vs general-purpose AI models

publications.title: Pebbble - Crafting Presence Through Code
publications.description: Pebbble is a design-driven project born from a deeply human need — to preserve the irreplaceable bond of a parent's voice across physical and digital divides. It blends ancient ritual, modern cryptography, and crafted hardware into a secure, tactile experience. Drawing from Japanese joinery philosophy, it redefines technology as a vessel of presence, resilience, and love.
